verdict.rationale: React's official docs offer a no-install, in-browser editable sandbox ('You don't need to install anything to play with React. Try editing this sandbox!'). They also offer a hands-on tic-tac-toe tutorial that assumes no prior React knowledge, which together cover the core of the story. missing for 10: explicit evidence that the guided tutorial itself runs fully in-browser rather than only alongside the sandbox, independent or hands-on corroboration of the tutorial experience.
